title: Start a small process
summary: Erlang: Start a small process. Send 7 * 2 instead.
introduction: spawn starts a new process. It can send a result back to the parent process.
learningObjectives: Start a small process with Erlang

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.

blocks.title: Start a small process
blocks.code:
-module(lesson).
-export([main/0]).
main() ->
    Parent = self(),
    spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {answer, 4 * 2} end),
    receive {answer, N} -> io:format("~p~n", [N]) end.

blocks.text: The spawned process calculates 8 and sends it to Parent. The parent waits for that answer.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Processes have their own data; share results with messages.
